headline: Readiness bottomed at 18 the morning after yesterday's long run turned into a threshold effort — today is a floor day, not a training day.
body_state: Training readiness is 18/100 (Low) — the lowest of this block, one day after Sunday's long run closed at 179-184bpm instead of the prescribed easy pace. Body battery sits at 41, resting HR 52 vs your 49.3 baseline (elevated), sleep score 73 off 6.4h last night, and you're carrying 23h of 14-day sleep debt. HRV itself reads BALANCED (40ms) — this isn't a pure HRV crash, it's accumulated load: four RPE≥5 sessions in the three days before yesterday's effort, this week's acute:chronic sitting at 2.29, TSB -24. Garmin's own status still says "Recovery," but the readiness number says treat today as a floor.
session: Today's slot is the Un1t HYROX class (~45min cross-training). At readiness 18 and body battery 41 — the lowest combo of the block — this isn't the day to chase class intensity. Keep it conversational throughout: skip anything resembling a max round, hold HR under 140-145bpm, treat it as movement and technique rather than conditioning. If body battery hasn't climbed by class time, a walk or full rest beats grinding through it — tomorrow's hyrox_mixed session needs you recovered, not further dug in.
recent: Aug 3: 95min road bike. Aug 4-6: near-daily Un1t/cardio classes (42-45min, HR 119-141, RPE 6-8), with an easy run squeezed into the same day as one of them on Aug 5. Aug 7: the "8km Progressive Long Run" averaged 4:25/km and 158bpm but closed at 179-184bpm (92-94% max) — the per-activity analysis flagged it as a threshold session wearing an easy-run label, self-rated RPE 8. Cadence stayed low again (162spm, stride lengthening late) — the same efficiency pattern called out in prior reviews. Four RPE≥5 days packed into three days ahead of that effort is exactly what's driving today's readiness floor.
focus: Today: conversational only, HR under 145 — skip or shorten the Un1t class if body battery hasn't recovered.
Respect "easy" labels going forward — yesterday's long run ran ~50s/km quicker than prescribed and closed near max HR.
Cadence: drive turnover to 168-172spm before letting stride open up — still the recurring economy gap.
